description: This is a test class for the EmployeeOnLeaveDao, containing unit tests for fetching and counting employee leave data in the HRM system. It sets up test data, mocks services, and asserts expected behavior of the DAO methods.

classes.name: EmployeeOnLeaveDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing EmployeeOnLeaveDao methods related to employee leave data retrieval and count in the OrangeHRM Dashboard plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a new EmployeeOnLeaveDao instance, loads test fixtures, and prepares the test environment.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveList
methods.description: Validates the retrieval of employee on-leave records with various date filters and access permissions, asserting correct data is returned.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeOnLeaveCount
methods.description: Validates the counting of employee on-leave records under different filters, ensuring the DAO correctly computes record counts.
